modern: Revere the faculty which produces opinion. On this faculty it depends entirely whether there will exist in your ruling part any opinion inconsistent with nature and with the makeup of the rational animal. And this faculty promises freedom from hasty judgement, and friendship towards men, and obedience to the gods.
